rules.statement: Collation takes place only when a parent gives property to his children, either on the occasion of their marriage or to advance or establish them in life.
rules.supporting_quote: "The Roman-Dutch law as to collation was superseded by section 39 of Ordinance No. 15 of 1876, and now collation takes place only when a parent gives property to his children, either on the occasion of their marriage or to advance or establish them in life."
